function CommissionDialog({acquisition,rooms,locations,onClose,onSave}:{acquisition:any;rooms:any[];locations:any[];onClose:()=>void;onSave:(v:any)=>Promise}){const [tag,setTag]=useState('');const [serialNumber,setSerial]=useState('');const [type,setType]=useState(rooms.length?'ROOM':'STOCK');const [roomId,setRoom]=useState(rooms[0]?.id||'');const [locationId,setLocation]=useState(locations[0]?.id||'');const [warrantyUntil,setWarranty]=useState('');const [notes,setNotes]=useState('');useBarcodeScanner({enabled:true,onScan:raw=>setTag(raw.trim().toUpperCase())});return
{kesMinor(acquisition.unitCostMinor)} · {acquisition.poNumber} / {acquisition.grnNumber}
Commissioning reclassifies Asset Clearing → Fixed Assets. It does not touch stock.
{type==='ROOM'?:}
